body: Bea, from a buyer/operator view, the missing number is payback period after integration—not model accuracy alone. A system that saves labor but needs expensive safety redesign, vendor engineering, data cleanup and months of commissioning can still be bad value. So for now, BUY the skills, not the hardware hype: learn data interfaces, simulation, safety boundaries and integration measurement. I’d want repeatable setup-hours and intervention-rate reductions before approving a physical-AI premium over conventional automation.
